## Overview

Single-file Three.js arcade flight sim served by Bun. The canonical game file is `flight-sim3.html` at the project root (16,241 lines as of HEAD `2d617f3`). Physics, HUD, combat, touch controls, mobile layout, multiplayer, and settings all live in that one file. Multiple AI agents (Claude, Codex/GPT-5.5) collaborate through the CodeSurf canvas peer protocol. A static build pipeline targets Netlify deployment.

- `bun run start` — launches web server + multiplayer server concurrently

- `bun run dev` — watched static server

### Build & deploy

- `bun run build` → `dist/` via `tools/build-game.mjs`; Netlify target (Node 22 / Bun 1.3.13)
- `game.html` = must-revalidate cache; `models/*` / `audio/*` = 1-year immutable cache
- Tweak loading: `/api/tweaks` in dev, `plane-tweaks.json` (no-cache) in static builds
- `bun run preview:dist` — local preview of the built `dist/`

## Active Subsystem Behaviour

### Touch controls (added 2026-05-04, commits 7ff6580 + 06bfdb2)

- Full touchscreen UI: virtual joystick (left thumb area), throttle slider (right), action buttons
- ARIA-labelled markup; CSS covers responsive/landscape/safe-area insets
- `window.__touchControls` — live touch state; `window.__syncTouchControls` — force-sync
- `syncTouchVirtualGamepad()` called from `pollGamepad()` — maps touch state to virtual gamepad events
- Touch input resets when options panel opens; HUD adapts for coarse-pointer/landscape
- `visualViewport` resize/scroll listeners trigger window resize for mobile layout

### Camera (fixed 2026-05-03)

- FOV narrowed to 60–68° raw lens range (was ~76–99° dynamic; caused fisheye edge stretch)
- Aspect-corrected vertical FOV: `2 * Math.atan(Math.tan(fov/2) / aspect)`
- Chase camera moved slightly farther back to reframe at narrower FOV
- Radial motion-blur edge sampling reduced; blur UV reads clamped

### Physics & controls

- Fixed-step physics, arcade rate-command pitch/roll/yaw, angular velocity caps
- Sideslip damping, turn energy bleed, high-speed control falloff
- Gamepad: Xbox/PlayStation/generic, trigger-axis fallback, double-deadzone fix
- `window.__ap.setGamepad()` / `clearGamepad()` for automated tests
- `advanceTime()` / `window.__ap` bridge for headless driving

### Multiplayer race mode

- `N` key or HUD button starts shared countdown; remote clients auto-adopt
- Left-side HUD: timer, room size, gate progress, best time, leaderboard
- Practice-course gate scoring feeds race progress and finish timing

### Telemetry bridge

- `window.__ap.telemetry()` returns multiplayer/traffic/combat/flight data
- `render_game_to_text` for headless state snapshots

## Known Bugs (unfixed as of 2026-05-04)

- **Startup free kill** — `combat_kills: 1` before player input; runway traffic intersects parked player, collision fires at zero speed
- **Reticle gated behind `mouseFlight`** — defaults `false`; keyboard players get no gunsight despite combat being keyboard-first
- **Reticle follows mouse NDC, not gun-line** — no spring/lag; not from actual muzzle trajectory
- **Resize/fullscreen corrupts mouse-flight target** — resize handler clamps normalised values as pixels
